prompt: A delivery drone has a base battery consumption rate of 1 unit per 10 km when flying empty. When carrying a package, its consumption rate increases by 25%. The drone performs a round trip from its base to a destination 200 km away. On the outbound journey, it carries the package. On the return journey, it carries the package for the first 50 km, and then drops it, completing the rest of the journey empty. What is the total battery consumed for the entire round trip?
